blocks.text: Only the third person of its present tense survives, and **буду** is its future, not its present.
«Notice the stress in the negative past: **не был**, **не была**, **не было**, **не были**.»
есть, дать, хотеть, бежать, идти, ехать

exercises.why: **есть → ем** — present tense, 1st person singular: ending -ем belongs to the first (е) conjugation.
**есть → ест** — the он form. These seven verbs follow neither conjugation throughout.
**есть → едим** — present tense, 1st person plural: ending -им belongs to the second (и) conjugation.
**есть → едите** — present tense, 2nd person plural: ending -ите belongs to the second (и) conjugation.
**есть → ел** — past tense, masc. (irregular stem).
**есть → ешьте** — imperative, polite / plural: the singular ешь + -те.
**дать → дам** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.
**дать → дашь** — perfective verb, 2nd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.
**дать → даст** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.
**дать → дадим** — perfective verb, 1st person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.
**дать → дадите** — perfective verb, 2nd person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.
**дать → дал** — past tense, masc.: drop -ть, add -л.
**дать → дай** — imperative, singular (to «ты»): ending -й (stem ends in a vowel).
**дать → дайте** — imperative, polite / plural: the singular дай + -те.
**хотеть → хочу** — present tense, 1st person singular.
**хотеть → хочешь** — present tense, 2nd person singular: ending -ешь belongs to the first (е) conjugation.
**хотеть → хочет** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.
**хотеть → хотим** — present tense, 1st person plural: ending -им belongs to the second (и) conjugation.
**хотеть → хотел** — past tense, masc.: drop -ть, add -л.
**хотеть → хоти** — imperative, singular (to «ты»): ending -и.
**бежать → бегу** — present-type form, 1st person singular.
**бежать → бежишь** — present-type form, 2nd person singular: ending -ишь belongs to the second (и) conjugation.
**бежать → бежит** — present-type form, 3rd person singular: ending -ит belongs to the second (и) conjugation.
**бежать → бежим** — present-type form, 1st person plural: ending -им belongs to the second (и) conjugation.
**бежать → бежите** — present-type form, 2nd person plural: ending -ите belongs to the second (и) conjugation.
**бежать → бежал** — past tense, masc.: drop -ть, add -л.
**бежать → беги** — imperative, singular (to «ты»): ending -и.
**бежать → бегите** — imperative, polite / plural: the singular беги + -те.
**идти → иду** — present tense, 1st person singular.
**идти → идёшь** — present tense, 2nd person singular: ending -ешь belongs to the first (е) conjugation.
**идти → идёт** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.
**идти → идём** — present tense, 1st person plural: ending -ем belongs to the first (е) conjugation.
**идти → идёте** — present tense, 2nd person plural: ending -ете belongs to the first (е) conjugation.
**идти → шёл** — past tense, masc. (irregular stem).
**идти → иди** — imperative, singular (to «ты»): ending -и.
**идти → идите** — imperative, polite / plural: the singular иди + -те.
**ехать → еду** — present tense, 1st person singular.
**ехать → едешь** — present tense, 2nd person singular: ending -ешь belongs to the first (е) conjugation.
**ехать → едет** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.
**ехать → едем** — present tense, 1st person plural: ending -ем belongs to the first (е) conjugation.
**ехать → едете** — present tense, 2nd person plural: ending -ете belongs to the first (е) conjugation.
**ехать → ехал** — past tense, masc.: drop -ть, add -л.
**ехать → езжай** — imperative, singular (to «ты»): ending -й (stem ends in a vowel).
**ехать → езжайте** — imperative, polite / plural: the singular езжай + -те.
**быть → буду** — future of быть: 1st person singular.
**быть → будешь** — future of быть: 2nd person singular.
**быть → будем** — future of быть: 1st person plural.
**быть → будете** — future of быть: 2nd person plural.
**быть → был** — past tense, masc.: drop -ть, add -л.
**быть → будь** — imperative, singular (to «ты»): ending -ь.
**быть → будьте** — imperative, polite / plural: the singular будь + -те.
